pre_run_questions.money_hypothesis: A locally first-seen original NDA/BLA approval may mark regulatory de-risking and improve the listed sponsor's next-open through 10-session replacement value; this experiment repairs only the prospective event producer.
pre_run_questions.history_and_novelty: exp-20260713-006 accepted the observer but daily production stayed pinned to its seed ZIP. Fourteen calendar days later the surface still had zero forward rows and status=ok. No open Drugs@FDA ticket existed; novelty nearest score was 0.4967 and the fault-recovery guard passed.
pre_run_questions.single_policy_bundle: Fixed official download, bounded timeout and size, immutable daily ZIP plus manifest, manifest retrieval clock, producer-before-consumer wiring, fail-closed health, and explicit zero-event heartbeat; all alpha rules are locked.
pre_run_questions.acceptance: A real unconfigured run must validate and freeze the current official source, consume it at the manifest clock, append previously unseen applications once, reuse the same daily artifacts idempotently, expose healthy zero-event output distinctly from starvation, pass focused tests and audit, and leave Gate-1 identity unchanged.
pre_run_questions.reproducibility: Use the reproduction commands against the frozen 2026-07-28 ZIP and manifest.
pre_run_questions.opportunity_cost: Cash/no new executable entry remains the current cross-sectional winner; no alpha reopen lane has gate-ready settled evidence.
pre_run_questions.cross_surface_boundary: Price, flow, derivatives, events, positioning, and portfolio exposure were synthesized. The Drugs@FDA producer fault directly blocked calendar-time evidence accumulation, so measurement repair displaced an otherwise premature alpha experiment.

fault_reproduction.root_cause: quant/run.py only checked for the fixed seed ZIP and reparsed it. It never acquired a current official vintage, and persist_drugsfda_approval_observer used the process clock on each rerun, so source freshness and process success diverged.

post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The parser and append-only ledger were sound, but production confused reparsing a static seed with refreshing the source. A current official snapshot immediately exposed seven applications that had never been locally observed.
post_run_reflection.irrecoverable_gap: The missing July 14-27 daily vintages cannot be reconstructed as forward evidence. The seven recovered rows become valid only at the 2026-07-28 manifest retrieval clock, never at their historical approval dates.
post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not backdate the seven recovered applications, treat approval dates as availability, infer ticker mappings from sponsor names without an audited relation, relax the source/manifest health contract, or claim alpha from these unsettled rows.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: No further producer ID is needed unless a real source, schema, retrieval-clock, or health regression occurs. Alpha evaluation remains parked until the frozen mapped and settled replacement-value threshold passes.
